verdict.rationale: Ledgy's marketing pages say grants, documents and signature workflows can be run in bulk, with contracts created, signed and shared in a few clicks (ledgy-docs-10, ledgy-docs-12). However, the documented API exposes only read operations (auth, companyCaptable, companyTransactions with paging and changed-since retrieval), so an AI-native user gets bulk reads programmatically but no evidenced bulk write or mutation path. Missing for 10: API-level bulk create/update/delete operations, documentation of bulk-operation limits or behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of the UI bulk features.
